decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly assembling a combo with cards that enable fast creature reanimation, card draw, and sacrificing creatures for value. The goal is to use First Day of Class to reduce the cost of spells, generate card advantage, and fuel the combo pieces. By using cards like Skirk Prospector and Deadly Dispute, the deck can sacrifice creatures like Putrid Goblin to generate mana and draw cards, eventually setting up a win condition with cards like Exhume and Makeshift Munitions. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient combo.

This deck focuses on using defender creatures to generate mana and combo off to create infinite mana loops with Freed from the Real and Galvanic Alchemist. The key idea is to efficiently ramp up your mana production with walls like Overgrown Battlement and Axebane Guardian, while using Quirion Ranger to untap lands and generate more mana. Lead the Stampede and Winding Way help to find combo pieces quickly, while Reaping the Graves can return them from the graveyard. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful combo finish.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifact creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient removal. It combines the strength of affinity with the versatility of countermagic to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a steady stream of threats. By efficiently sacrificing artifacts and utilizing spells like Galvanic Blast and Cast Down, the deck aims to control the board and push through damage quickly. The mana base is optimized for casting a variety of colored spells and ensures consistency in deploying threats.

This deck is focused on fast and aggressive gameplay, using cheap and efficient spells and creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. With a low mana curve and plenty of direct damage spells like Lava Dart, Lightning Bolt, and Chain Lightning, this deck aims to burn the opponent out before they have a chance to stabilize. Cards like Goblin Bushwhacker and Kuldotha Rebirth allow for explosive starts, while creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Blast-Runner can apply pressure early on. With a focus on quick tempo and aggression, this deck aims to win the game as quickly as possible.

The main objective of this deck is to control the game using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and defensive creatures while gaining card advantage through card draw and tutoring effects. The Gates lands provide additional mana fixing and can help ramp up to bigger spells. By controlling the board and resource management, this deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through attrition.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy with a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw. By efficiently removing threats and countering important spells, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and out-value the opponent. The deck includes powerful finishers like Gurmag Angler to close out the game once the opponent has been sufficiently slowed down. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Mental Note and Thought Scour to fill the graveyard for potential extra value.

This deck focuses on building a fast and aggressive strategy by using low-cost and efficient white creatures. The main idea is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small creatures like Squadron Hawks and Thraben Inspectors. The deck also includes cards like Journey to Nowhere and Prismatic Strands to control the opponent's board and protect our creatures. Guardians' Pledge and Battle Screech provide additional ways to pump up our team and deal extra damage. Additionally, the inclusion of Militia Bugler and Raffine's Informant allows us to maintain card advantage and keep our momentum going.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent through a combination of cheap burn spells, efficient creatures, and artifacts that can deal damage. By using cards like Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Monastery Swiftspear, and Goblin Blast-Runner, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game as quickly as possible. Additionally, cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Implement of Combustion provide support and additional ways to deal damage while maintaining a fast pace of play.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by using removal spells, creature sacrifice effects, and card draw in order to outvalue the opponent. By utilizing a mix of Golgari and Jund cards, the deck aims to generate incremental advantage through cards like Crypt Rats, Chainer's Edict, and Ichor Wellspring. The deck also includes various utility lands like Khalni Garden and Bojuka Bog to further support its control strategy. Overall, the deck is designed to grind out wins through attrition and card advantage.

This deck focuses on playing low-cost artifacts to quickly overwhelm the opponent with creatures and efficient removal spells. It takes advantage of the affinity mechanic to help cast its spells for cheap, while also utilizing sacrifice effects to gain value from artifacts leaving the battlefield. The deck also includes some card draw and counter spells to help maintain its resources and protect its threats. Overall, the key strategy is to be aggressive with artifact creatures and efficient removal, while leveraging sacrifice and card advantage to stay ahead in the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures like Guardian of the Guildpact. The deck utilizes cards like Prismatic Strands and Squadron Hawk for protection and card advantage, while also utilizing Gates to fix mana and generate additional value. With a solid mix of control elements and card draw, this deck aims to outlast opponents and take control of the game in the mid to late stages.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly build up a board of artifact creatures while utilizing cheap artifacts and sacrifice effects to control the board and deal damage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures like Myr Enforcer and Frogmite, while also using cards like Kenku Artificer and Deadly Dispute to generate value and card advantage. The inclusion of burn spells like Galvanic Blast adds reach to finish off the opponent. The synergy between artifact creatures and sacrifice effects creates a strong aggressive strategy in the affinity archetype.

The main focus of this UR Control Pauper deck is to disrupt and control the opponent through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. The deck utilizes cards like Counterspell, Skred, and Lightning Bolt to address threats, while also including creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Augur of Bolas for additional value. Faerie Seer and Spellstutter Sprite offer early game board presence and interaction. With a mix of card draw, counterspells, and removal, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The main idea behind this deck is to use cheap and efficient creatures/spells to control the board and apply pressure to the opponent quickly. The deck aims to establish early board presence with creatures like Faerie Seer and Faerie Miscreant, while utilizing counterspells like Counterspell to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Snap and Vapor Snag provide utility by bouncing threats or clearing blockers, allowing aggressive creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Brinebarrow Intruder to get in for damage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of creatures and disruption spells.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while efficiently controlling the game with counterspells and removal spells. The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with cards such as Mental Note and Thought Scour to enable the powerful delve ability of Gurmag Angler. Unexpected Fangs and Tolarian Terror provide additional protection and disruption, while Fallaji Archaeologist allows for graveyard recursion. With a mix of card draw, removal, and counterspells, this deck aims to outlast opponents and secure victory through card advantage and tempo control.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and utility creatures. The deck focuses on using Gates to fix mana and gain card advantage, while also utilizing creatures like Squadron Hawk and Guardian of the Guildpact to maintain board presence and pressure opponents. The deck also includes various card draw and selection spells to ensure consistency and enable efficient plays. Additionally, the inclusion of Prismatic Strands provides a way to protect key creatures and disrupt opponent's strategies.
